صَهْصَلِقٌ A vehement voice. (S, O, K.) A rájiz says, “قَدْ شَيَّبَتْ رَأْسِى بِصَوْتٍ صَهْصَلِقٌ
” [She has rendered my head hoary by a vehement voice]. (TA.) ―
-b2- And A clamorous old woman; (S, O, K, TA;) vehement of voice; (TA;) and so صَهْصَلَقٌ; (TA;) so too ↓ صَهْصَلِيقٌ . (As, S, O, K.) صَهْصَلِقُ الصَّوْتِ is applied to a man, as meaning Vehement of voice: and in like manner to a hawk. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
